desc.zh: 主力编辑器，装几个插件就能覆盖前端、脚本和 Markdown 写作。
desc.en: Main editor. A handful of extensions covers front-end work, scripts and Markdown writing.

desc.zh: 版本管理的基础设施，GitHub Pages 部署流程也绕不开它。
desc.en: The foundation of version control — and the path to deploying on GitHub Pages.

desc.zh: 画页面草图、导出 SVG 图标，免费额度对个人项目够用。
desc.en: Sketch layouts and export SVG icons. The free tier is enough for personal projects.

desc.zh: 快捷启动器加插件市场，剪贴板、翻译、截图一步到位。
desc.en: A launcher with a plugin market — clipboard, translation and screenshots in one keystroke.

desc.zh: 本地 Markdown 笔记，双链整理资料；文件都在本地，不怕平台跑路。
desc.en: Local Markdown notes with backlinks. Your files stay on disk, immune to platform shifts.

desc.zh: Windows 上的效率增强包，窗口布局、批量重命名、取色器都很好用。
desc.en: An efficiency pack for Windows: window layouts, bulk rename and a colour picker.

desc.zh: 多标签、分屏和自定义配色，配合 WSL 用起来比自带终端顺很多。
desc.en: Tabs, panes and custom themes — far smoother than the built-in console, especially with WSL.

desc.zh: 老牌压缩工具，格式支持全、没广告，装系统后第一批必装之一。
desc.en: The veteran archiver: broad format support, no ads. One of the first things I install.

desc.zh: 带连字的等宽字体，写代码时辨识度更好，编辑器里换一下就知道差别。
desc.en: Ligature monospace fonts that make code easier to scan — swap them in your editor to feel it.

desc.zh: 手绘风格白板，画架构图和流程示意很快，不用登录也能直接用。
desc.en: A hand-drawn style whiteboard for quick architecture sketches — usable without signing in.

desc.zh: 秒级全盘文件名搜索，Windows 上找文件的神器，资源占用很低。
desc.en: Instant whole-disk filename search for Windows. Minimal footprint, indispensable.

desc.zh: 本地跑容器最简单的方式，环境隔离后「在我机器上是好的」这类问题少很多。
desc.en: The easiest way to run containers locally. Environment isolation kills most "works on my machine" bugs.

desc.zh: 调接口必备，Hoppscotch 是开源替代，浏览器里直接能用、更轻。
desc.en: Essential for API work. Hoppscotch is the open-source alternative — lighter and browser-based.
